caption: The drawing features a rectangular area with a scalloped bottom edge, filled with tightly spaced vertical yellow and gold lines, creating a textured, striped background. Four groups of flowers are arranged asymmetrically within this yellow field. Each floral cluster includes blooms in shades of pink, red, purple, and white, accented by green leaves with various shades and minor touches of blue. The largest bouquet is situated right of center, while three smaller clusters are positioned in the upper left, lower left, and lower right areas of the composition. The entire yellow and floral section is bordered by a plain, beige outer area, with the design centered on the page.
title: Silk with Embroidered Flowers
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
